status: Specified before fitting this replacement, after inspecting the original forecasts and their error audit. Exploratory development, not a fresh holdout.
source: Same annual verified ProQuest 1900–2010 panel and frozen historical macro vintages; no source edits or new claims
target: Six-month industrial-production direction from t-1 to t+5 with inclusive +/-2 percent flat band. Final revised truth is used only after forecasting for evaluation.
evaluation_support: Exactly the original core 408 and CPI 108 evaluation months, including its documented exclusion of 2001 from the CPI study
eligibility: All original macro and four press features observed; same eligible source months as the preceding comparison; no imputation
training_window_definition: recent_120 uses the latest 120 eligible mature training months; expanding uses all eligible mature months. No future rows or revised evaluation truth enter either.
refits: January annually; same historical IPT label vintage and three-month maturity rule at every outer and inner refit

inner_validation.rule: For each outer January, build annual folds at the prior five January origins. Fit each fold using its own as-of-inner-refit labels and training-only standardization. Predict the subsequent calendar year, restricted to origins whose labels are mature and available in the outer January vintage. Score inner predictions against those as-of-outer-refit labels, never final revised evaluation truth.
inner_validation.common_support: Every eligible candidate is scored on exactly the same inner validation months. A candidate with insufficient training history or a missing training class at any eligible inner refit is unavailable for that outer selection.
inner_validation.criterion: Mean multiclass Brier loss across all common validation months; no adjustment based on outer evaluation outcomes
inner_validation.tie_break: Lowest score; numerical ties within 1e-12 prefer fewer macro features, smaller C, then expanding history
inner_validation.fallback: If fewer than 24 validation months or two valid annual folds exist, use production features, C=0.001, expanding history. CPI appends its fixed inflation feature. Record fallback explicitly.

macro_plus_press: Add the same four press signals using the macro-selected feature set, C and training window. Do not retune these settings using press performance. Both regressions share the same training months.
recent_base_rate: Original Laplace-smoothed latest 120 eligible mature labels; unchanged comparator
preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only on the relevant inner or outer training rows. No winsorization, class weighting, feature interactions, probability clipping or fitted recalibration.
primary_comparison: Selected macro plus press versus selected macro alone, core study
primary_metric: Multiclass Brier score, sum over three classes, range 0–2
calibration: Fixed tenths probability bins per class; report forecast counts, confidence and accuracy for predictions with maximum probability >=0.9; no evaluation-set recalibration
stability: Same calendar five-year/decade cells, omission of 2007–2009 scoring origins, and leave-one-five-year-cell-out scoring as the preceding experiment; no refit for scoring exclusions
uncertainty: Paired year-block resampling anchored at each study evaluation start. Fixed fitted forecasts; not a nested bootstrap of model selection. CPI long-block intervals have too few blocks for strong inference.
limitations: Feature choices motivated by already inspected results; repeated historical evaluation remains exploratory. Vintage reconstruction, quarterly macro staleness, query selection, human-validation gaps and overlapping six-month outcomes remain. Revisions between inner and outer vintages can alter validation labels but are known at outer selection time.
